page.layout: One page of text: a single column of Greek headwords with Latin glosses, one entry per line, with a short line below the last entry at the right. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.l: πρᾶξις actio, Πρᾶξιλλα proprium, quasi actiuncula.
παῖς puer, παιδίσκος puellus, παιδίσκη puella.
χάρις gratia, Χαρίνος proprium, tanquam gratiosulus.
κόρη puella, Κόρινα, & metri causa Κό-ρινα, proprium, quasi puellula.

page.notes: The Greek words are set in a small, worn Greek type and some letters, especially breathings, accents and the sequence in the first and fifth entries, are doubtful; these are marked [?]. The catchword at the lower right is a single Greek word and may be partly lost. The entry-initial headword in several lines is faint.
